name: Maximum current limit too low.
remedy: Check settings of parameters 99.06 Motor nominal current and 30.17 Maximum current. Make sure that 30.17 > 99.06.; Check that the drive is dimensioned correctly according to the motor.

name: Maximum speed limit or calculated field weakening point too low.
remedy: Check settings of parameters • 30.11 Minimum speed • 30.12 Maximum speed • 99.07 Motor nominal voltage • 99.08 Motor nominal frequency • 99.09 Motor nominal speed. Make sure that • 30.12 > (0.55 × 99.09) > (0.50 × synchronous speed) • 30.11 < 0, and • supply voltage ≥ (0.66 × 99.07).

name: Maximum torque limit too low.
remedy: Check settings of parameter 99.12 Motor nominal torque, and the torque limits in group 30 Limits. Make sure that the maximum torque limit in force is greater than 100%.

name: Current measurement calibration did not finish within reasonable time
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.; Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

name: Motor not connected to the drive.
remedy: Check the motor connection.

name: Internal error.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Deceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
remedy: Restore the template program or download the program to the drive.

name: Speed dropped to zero during ID run.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: First acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Second acceleration did not finish within reasonable time.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Program corrupted or block non-existent
remedy: Restore the template program or download the program to the drive.

name: Internal error.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Program too large.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Motor too large for advanced standstill ID run.
causes: Correct the program and download it to the drive.
remedy: Check that the motor and drive sizes are compatible.

name: Motor data error.
remedy: Check that the motor nominal value settings in the drive are the same as in the motor nameplate.

name: A non-existing parameter or block is used in the program.
causes: Edit the program to correct the parameter reference, or to use an existing block.

name: Parameter type invalid for selected pin.
causes: Edit the program to correct the parameter reference.

name: Output to parameter failed because the parameter was write-protected.
remedy: Check the parameter reference in the program. Check for other sources affecting the target parameter.; Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

name: Backup/Restore timeout
causes: Panel or PC tool has failed to communicate with the drive when backup was being made or restored.
remedy: Request backup or restore again.

name: Earth leakage
causes: Drive has detected load unbalance typically due to earth fault in motor or motor cable
remedy: Check there are no power factor correction capacitors or surge absorbers in motor cable; Check for an earth fault in motor or motor cables by measuring the insulation resistances of motor and motor cable; Try running the motor in scalar control mode if allowed; If no earth fault can be detected, contact your local ABB representative

name: Output phase loss
remedy: The drive trips on fault 3381 Output phase loss.

name: Control board temperature
causes: Control unit temperature is too high.
remedy: Check proper cooling of the drive. Check the auxiliary cooling fan.

name: IGBT overtemperature
causes: Estimated drive IGBT temperature is excessive.
remedy: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

name: Cooling
causes: Drive module temperature is excessive.
remedy: Check ambient temperature. If it exceeds 40 °C/104 °F (IP21 frames R4…R9) or if it exceeds 50 °C /122 °F (IP21 frames R0…R9), ensure that load current does not exceed derated load capacity of drive. For all P55 frames, check the derating temperatures. See chapter Technical data, section Derating in the Hardware manual of the drive. Check drive module cooling air flow and fan operation. Check inside of cabinet and heatsink of drive module for dust pick-up. Clean whenever necessary.

name: IGBT temperature
causes: Drive IGBT temperature is excessive.
remedy: Check ambient conditions. Check air flow and fan operation. Check heatsink fins for dust pick-up. Check motor power against drive power.

name: Excess temperature
causes: Power unit module temperature is excessive.
remedy: See A4B0 Excess temperature (page 412).

name: Excess temperature difference
causes: High temperature difference between the IGBTs of different phases.
remedy: Check the motor cabling. Check cooling of drive module(s).

name: External temperature 1
causes: Measured temperature 1 has exceeded fault limit.
remedy: Check the value of parameter 35.02 Measured temperature 1. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured).
clearing: Fault is reset when PTC decreases below recovery threshold

name: External temperature 2
causes: PTC over triggering threshold; PTC below recovery threshold
remedy: Check the value of parameter 35.03 Measured temperature 2. Check the cooling of the motor (or other equipment whose temperature is being measured).
clearing: fault reset

name: CPTC-02 not found
causes: CPTC-02 extension module is not detected in option slot 2.
remedy: Power down the drive and check that the module is properly inserted in option slot 2. See also CPTC-02 ATEX-certified thermistor protection module, Ex II (2) GD (+L537+Q971) user's manual (3AXD50000030058 [English].

name: Safe motor temperature
causes: The CPTC-02 module indicates overtemperature: • motor temperature is too high, or • the thermistor is in short-circuit or disconnected
remedy: Check the cooling of the motor. Check the motor load and drive ratings. Check the wiring of the temperature sensor. Repair wiring if faulty. Measure the resistance of the sensor. Replace the sensor if faulty.

name: Fan
causes: Cooling fan feedback missing.
remedy: See A581 Fan (page 412).

name: Auxiliary fan broken
causes: An auxiliary cooling fan (connected to the fan connectors on the control unit) is stuck or disconnected.
remedy: Check the auxiliary code. Check auxiliary fan(s) and connection(s). Replace fan if faulty. Make sure the front cover of the drive is in place and tightened. If the commissioning of the drive requires th the cover is off, activate parameter 31.36 Aux fan fault bybass within 2 min from control unit reboot to temporarily suppress the fault. Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

name: Measurement circuit DFF
causes: Measurement circuit fault.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: PU state feedback
causes: State feedback from output phases does not match control signals.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Charging feedback
causes: Charging feedback signal missing.
remedy: Check the feedback signal coming from the charging system

name: Unknown PU fault
causes: The power unit logic has generated a fault which is not known by the software.
remedy: Check the logic and software compatibility.

name: Communication diagnostics
causes: EFB initialization failed; Node address not allowed by protocol; Drive not allowed to transmit; Automatic detection of baud rate is in use; Errors detected (A/B wires possibly swapped); Error detected: check parameters 58.04 and 58.05; Error detected: check parameters 58.05 and 58.04; 0 bytes received during last 5 seconds; 0 packets (addressed to any device) detected during last 5 seconds; Errors detected (interference, or another device with the same address on line); 0 packets addressed to the drive received within timeout; No control word or references received within timeout; Internal error occurred
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative
clearing: Press Reset for over 3 seconds

name: FPGA version incompatible
causes: Firmware and FPGA versions are incompatible.
remedy: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

name: FBA A mapping file
causes: Fieldbus adapter A mapping file read error.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Task overload
causes: Internal fault.
remedy: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

name: Stack overflow
causes: Internal fault.
remedy: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

name: Internal file load
causes: File read error.
remedy: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power. If the problem persists, contact your local ABB representative.

name: Rating ID fault
causes: Rating ID load error.
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative.

name: Adaptive program
causes: Error running the adaptive program.
remedy: Check the auxiliary code (format XXYY ZZZZ). "XX" specifies the number of the state (00=base program) and "YY" specifies the number of the function block (0000=generic error). "ZZZZ" indicates the problem.

name: Fault reset
causes: A fault has been reset from the panel, Drive composer PC tool, fieldbus or I/O.
remedy: Event. Informative only.

name: EFB comm loss
causes: Communication loss detected; control or reference expected from EFB; communication lost
remedy: Fault always; Warning
clearing: Press Reset for 3 seconds

name: EFB invalid parameterization
causes: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) parameter settings inconsistent or not compatible with selected protocol
remedy: Check the settings in parameter group 58 Embedded fieldbus

name: EFB load fault
causes: Embedded fieldbus (EFB) protocol firmware could not be loaded; Version mismatch between EFB protocol firmware and drive firmware
remedy: Contact your local ABB representative

name: EFB fault 2
causes: Fault reserved for the EFB protocol application
remedy: Check the documentation of the protocol

name: EFB fault 3
causes: Fault reserved for the EFB protocol application
remedy: Check the documentation of the protocol

name: Text 32-bit table overflow
causes: Internal fault
remedy: Reset the fault; Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists

name: Text file overflow
causes: Internal fault
remedy: Reset the fault; Contact your local ABB representative if the fault persists

name: Control panel loss
causes: Control panel or PC tool selected as active control location for drive has ceased communicating
remedy: Check PC tool or control panel connection; Check control panel connector; Disconnect and reconnect the control panel

name: Incompatible option module
causes: Fieldbus option module not supported
remedy: Replace the module with a supported type

name: Motor stall
causes: Motor is operating in stall region because of excessive load or insufficient motor power
remedy: Check motor load and drive ratings; Check fault function parameters

name: Brake resistor
causes: Brake resistor broken or not connected
remedy: Check that a brake resistor has been connected; Check the condition of the brake resistor; Check the dimensioning of the brake resistor

name: BR excess temperature
causes: Brake resistor temperature has exceeded fault limit defined by parameter 43.11 Brake resistor fault limit
remedy: Stop drive; Let resistor cool down; Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameter group 43 Brake chopper); Check fault limit setting, parameter 43.11 Brake resistor fault limit; Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits

name: Brake resistor wiring
causes: Brake resistor short circuit or brake chopper control fault
remedy: Check brake chopper and brake resistor connection; Ensure brake resistor is not damaged

name: BC short circuit
causes: Short circuit in brake chopper IGBT
remedy: Ensure brake resistor is connected and not damaged; Check the electrical specifications of the brake resistor against chapter Resistor braking in the Hardware manual of the drive; Replace brake chopper (if replaceable)

name: BC IGBT excess temperature
causes: Brake chopper IGBT temperature has exceeded internal fault limit
remedy: Let chopper cool down; Check for excessive ambient temperature; Check for cooling fan failure; Check for obstructions in the air flow; Check resistor overload protection function settings (parameter group 43 Brake chopper); Check that braking cycle meets allowed limits; Check that drive supply AC voltage is not excessive

name: AI supervision Programmable fault: 12.03 AI supervision function
causes: An analog signal is outside the limits specified for the analog input.
remedy: Check signal level at the analog input. Check the auxiliary code. Check the wiring connected to the input. Check the minimum and maximum limits of the input in parameter group 12 Standard AI.

name: External fault 4
causes: Fault in external device 4.
remedy: Check the external device.; Check setting of parameter 31.07 External event 4 source.

name: External fault 5
causes: Fault in external device 5.
remedy: Check the external device.; Check setting of parameter 31.09 External event 5 source.

name: ABB Signal supervision 1
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 1.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.07 Supervision 1 signal).

name: ABB Signal supervision 2
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 2.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.17 Supervision 2 signal).

name: ABB Signal supervision 3
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 3.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.27 Supervision 3 signal).

name: ABB Signal supervision 4
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 4.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.37 Supervision 4 signal).

name: ABB Signal supervision 5
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 5.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.47 Supervision 5 signal).

name: ABB Signal supervision 6
causes: Warning generated by the signal supervision function 6.
remedy: Check the source of the warning (parameter 32.57 Supervision 6 signal).

name: ULC overload warning
causes: Selected signal has exceeded the user overload curve.
remedy: Check for any operating conditions increasing the monitored signal (for example, the loading of the motor if the torque or current is being monitored). Check the definition of the load curve (parameter group 37 User load curve).

name: ULC underload warning
causes: Selected signal has fallen below the user underload curve.
remedy: Check for any operating conditions decreasing the monitored signal (for example, loss of load if the torque or current is being monitored). Check the definition of the load curve (parameter group 37 User load curve).

name: External warning 1
causes: Fault in external device 1.
remedy: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.01 External event 1 source.

name: External warning 2
causes: Fault in external device 2.
remedy: Check the external device. Check setting of parameter 31.03 External event 2 source.

name: External warning 3
causes: Fault in external device 3.
remedy: Check the external device.; Check setting of parameter 31.05 External event 3 source.

name: External warning 4
causes: Fault in external device 4.
remedy: Check the external device.; Check setting of parameter 31.07 External event 4 source.

name: External warning 5
causes: Fault in external device 5.
remedy: Check the external device.; Check setting of parameter 31.09 External event 5 source.

name: Season configuration warning
causes: You have configured a season which starts before the previous season.; Configure the seasons with increasing start dates, see parameters 34.60 Season 1 start date…34.63 Season 4 start date.

name: Process PID sleep mode
causes: The drive is entering sleep mode.; Informative warning. See section Sleep and boost functions for process PID control (page 116), and parameters 40.43…40.48.

name: Autoreset
causes: A fault is about to be autoreset.; Informative warning. See the settings in parameter group 31 Fault functions.

name: Emergency stop (off2)
causes: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection off2) command.; If the emergency stop was unintentional, check the source selected by parameter 21.05 Emergency stop source.
remedy: Check that it is safe to continue operation. Then return emergency stop push button to normal position. Restart drive.

name: Emergency stop (off1 or off3)
causes: Drive has received an emergency stop (mode selection off1 or off3) command.

name: Start delay
causes: The start delay is active and the drive will start the motor after a predefined delay.; Informative warning. See parameter 21.22 Start delay.

name: Run enable missing
causes: No run enable signal is received.
remedy: Check setting of parameter 20.12 Run enable 1 source. Switch signal on (e.g. in the fieldbus Control Word) or check wiring of selected source.

name: Enable to rotate
causes: Signal to rotate has not been received within a fixed time delay of 120 s.
remedy: Switch enable to rotate signal on (e.g. in digital inputs). Check the setting of (and source selected by) parameter 20.22 Enable to rotate.

name: Identification run
causes: Motor ID run will occur at next start.
remedy: Informative warning.

name: Motor heating active
causes: Pre-heating is being performed
remedy: Informative warning. Motor pre-heating is active. Current specified by parameter 21.16 Pre-heating current is being passed through the motor.

name: Safe torque off 1
causes: Safe torque off function is active, ie. STO circuit 1 is broken.
remedy: Check safety circuit connections.; Check the value of parameter 95.04 Control board supply.

name: Safe torque off 2
causes: Safe torque off function is active, ie. STO circuit 2 is broken.

name: ID run
causes: Motor ID run was not completed successfully.; Cycle the power to the drive (and its control unit, if powered separately).
remedy: Check the nominal motor values in parameter group 99 Motor data.; Check that no external control system is connected to the drive.; Check that no operation limits prevent the completion of the ID run. Restore parameters to default settings and try again.; Check that the motor shaft is not locked.; Check the auxiliary code. The second number of the code indicates the problem (see actions for each code below).

name: STO diagnostics failure.
causes: SW internal malfunction.
remedy: Reboot the control unit (using parameter 96.08 Control board boot) or by cycling power.

name: FB A force trip
causes: A fault trip command has been received through fieldbus adapter A.
remedy: Check the fault information provided by the PLC.

name: EFB force trip
causes: A fault trip command has been received through the embedded fieldbus interface.
remedy: Check the fault information provided by the PLC.

name: Dry running or water shortage
causes: For fault number 4, dry running, the pump must be reset manually

name: System overpressure
causes: The setpoint is set too high; The maximum pressure has been exceeded; Dry running or water shortage; The inlet pipe is blocked by impurities; The foot or non-return valve is blocked in closed position; There is a leakage in the inlet pipe; Air in the inlet pipe or the pump; The internal non-return valve is defective or blocked in completely or partly open position; The tank precharge pressure is not correct
remedy: Reduce the pressure to a new setpoint (maximum 3.5 bar (51 psi) + positive inlet pressure); Check the inlet conditions; Check the water source, and prime the pump; Clean the inlet pipe; Clean, repair or replace the foot or non-return valve; Repair the inlet pipe; Prime the inlet pipe and the pump. Check the inlet conditions of the pump; Clean, repair or replace the non-return valve; Adjust the tank precharge pressure to 70 % of the required outlet pressure

name: Maximum runtime exceeded
causes: The pump exceeds the running time of 30 minutes
clearing: press the buttons simultaneously for 5 seconds; The pump will stop after 30 minutes of continuous operation, and it will show alarm 6. This alarm will always need to be reset manually.

name: Load slipping
causes: The difference between the output frequency and the speed feedback is not correct.
remedy: Check the motor, gain and stability parameters; Add a braking resistor; Check the size of the motor/drive/load; Check the encoder's mechanical coupling and its wiring; Check the setting of parameters.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Angle error
causes: It occurs during the phase-shift angle measurement, if the motor phase is disconnected or if the motor inductance is too high.
remedy: Check the motor phases and the maximum current allowed by the drive.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Brake control
causes: Brake release current not reached; Brake engage frequency threshold [Brake engage freq] BEN only regulated when brake logic control is assigned.
remedy: Check the drive/motor connection; Check the motor windings; Check the [Brk Release Current] IBR and [Brake release I Rev] IRD settings; Apply the recommended settings for [Brake engage freq] BEN.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Incorrect configuration error
causes: Option module changed or removed; Control block replaced by a control block configured on a drive with a different rating; The current configuration is inconsistent
remedy: Check that there are no detected module errors; In the event of the option module being changed/removed deliberately, see the remarks below; Return to factory settings 1.3.2 [Factory settings] FCS-, page 90 or retrieve the backup configuration, if it is valid
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: Invalid configuration error
causes: The configuration loaded in the drive via the bus or communication network is inconsistent
remedy: Check the configuration loaded previously; Load a compatible configuration
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: Configuration transfer error
causes: The configuration loaded in the drive via the bus or communication network is inconsistent
remedy: Check the configuration loaded previously; Load a compatible configuration
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: Fieldbus Com Interrupt
causes: Communication interruption on communication module.
remedy: Check the environment (electromagnetic compatibility); Check the wiring; Check the time-out; Replace the option module; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: CANopen Com Interrupt
causes: Communication interruption on the CANopen® bus.
remedy: Check the communication bus; Check the time-out; Refer to the CANopen® User manual.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Precharge Capacitor
causes: Charging relay control detected error or charging resistor damaged.
remedy: Turn the drive off and then turn on again; Check the internal connections; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Ch Switch Error
remedy: Switch to not valid channels.; Check the function parameters.
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: EEprom control error
causes: Internal memory detected error, control block
remedy: Check the environment (electromagnetic compatibility); Turn off, reset, return to factory settings; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed

name: EEprom power error
causes: Internal memory detected error, power board
remedy: Check the environment (electromagnetic compatibility); Turn off, reset, return to factory settings; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed

name: External error
causes: Event triggered by an external device, depending on user
remedy: Check the device which caused the triggering and reset
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed

name: Fieldbus External Error
causes: Event triggered by a communication network.
remedy: Check for the cause of the triggering and reset.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Output contactor closed error
causes: The output contactor remains closed although the opening conditions have been met.
remedy: Check the contactor and its wiring; Check the feedback circuit.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Output contactor opened error
causes: The output contactor remains open although the closing conditions have been met.
remedy: Check the contactor and its wiring; Check the feedback circuit.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Boards compatibility error
causes: The [Boards pairing] PPI- function has been configured and a drive card has been changed.
remedy: In the event of a card error, reinsert the original card; Confirm the configuration by entering the [Pairing password] PPI if the card was changed deliberately.
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: IGBT desaturation error
causes: Short-circuit or grounding at the drive.
remedy: Check the cables connecting the drive to the motor, and the motor insulation.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal link error
causes: Communication interruption between option module and drive.
remedy: Check the environment (electromagnetic compatibility); Check the connections; Replace the option module; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 1 (Rating)
causes: The power board is different from the board stored.
remedy: Check the reference of the power board.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 2 (Soft)
causes: The power board is incompatible with the control block.
remedy: Check the reference of the power board and its compatibility.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 3 (Intern Comm)
causes: Communication interruption between the internal cards.
remedy: Check the internal connections; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 4 (Manufacturing)
causes: Internal data inconsistent.
remedy: Re-calibrate the drive (performed by Schneider Electric Product Support).
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 6 (Option)
causes: The option installed in the drive is not recognized.
remedy: Check the reference and compatibility of the option; Check that the option is well inserted into the ATV320.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 9 (Measure)
causes: The current measurements are incorrect.
remedy: Replace the current sensors or the power board; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 10 (Mains)
causes: The input stage is not operating correctly.
remedy: Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal error 11 (Temperature)
causes: The drive temperature sensor is not operating correctly.
remedy: Replace the drive temperature sensor; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Internal Error 14 (CPU) error
causes: Internal microprocessor detected error.
remedy: Turn off and reset.; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Input contactor error
causes: The drive is not turned on even though [Mains V. time out] LCT has elapsed.
remedy: Check the contactor and its wiring.; Check the time-out.; Check the supply mains /contactor /drive connection.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: AI3 4-20mA loss error
causes: Loss of the 4-20 mA reference on analog input AI3.
remedy: Check the connection on the analog inputs.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: DC bus overvoltage error
causes: Braking too sudden or driving load.; Supply voltage too high.
remedy: Increase the deceleration time.; Install a braking resistor if necessary.; Activate the [Dec.Ramp Adapt] BRA function, if it is compatible with the application.; Check the supply voltage.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Overcurrent
causes: Parameters in the [Settings] SET- and [Motor control] DRC- menus are not correct; Inertia or load too high; Mechanical locking
remedy: Check the parameters; Check the size of the motor/drive/load; Check the state of the mechanism; Decrease [Current Limitation] CLI; Increase the switching frequency
clearing: If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [No] NO : This detected error requires a power reset; If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [Yes] YES : This detected error can be cleared manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Drive overheating
causes: Drive temperature too high
remedy: Check the motor load, the drive ventilation and the ambient temperature. Wait for the drive to cool down before restarting
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Drive Overheat
causes: Thermal state exceeds 118% of rated state
remedy: Freewheel stop; Configured stop; Fallback speed; Speed maintained; Ramp stop; Fast stop; DC injection

name: Process overload
causes: Process overload
remedy: Check and remove the cause of the overload; Check the parameters of the [Process overload] OLD- function
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Motor overload
causes: Triggered by excessive motor current
remedy: Check the setting of the motor thermal protection, check the motor load. Wait for the motor to cool down before restarting
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Single Output Phase Loss
causes: Loss of one phase at drive output
remedy: Check the connections from the drive to the motor
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Output Phase Loss
causes: Motor not connected or motor power too low; Output contactor open; Instantaneous instability in the motor current
remedy: Check the connections from the drive to the motor; If an output contactor is being used, set [Output phase loss] OPL to [No Error Triggered] OAC; Test on a low power motor or without a motor; Check and optimize the following parameters: [IR compensation] UFR, page 105, [Nom Motor Voltage] UNS and [Nom Motor Current] NCR, page 99 and perform [Autotuning] TUN, page 100
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Supply Mains Overvoltage
causes: Supply voltage too high; Disturbed mains supply
remedy: Check the supply voltage
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Safety function detected error
causes: Debounce time exceeded; SS1 threshold exceeded; Incorrect configuration; SLS type overspeed detected
remedy: Check the safety functions configuration; Check the ATV320 Integrated safety Functions manual; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support
clearing: This detected error requires a power reset of the device after its cause has been removed.

name: Motor short circuit error
causes: Short-circuit or grounding at the drive output
remedy: Check the cables connecting the drive to the motor, and the motor insulation; Reduce the switching frequency; Connect chokes in series with the motor; Check the adjustment of speed loop and brake; Increase the [Time to restart] TTR; Increase the switching frequency
clearing: If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [No] NO : This detected error requires a power reset; If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [Yes] YES : This detected error can be cleared manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Ground short circuit error
causes: Significant earth leakage current at the drive output if several motors are connected in parallel
remedy: Check the cables connecting the drive to the motor, and the motor insulation; Reduce the switching frequency; Connect chokes in series with the motor; Check the adjustment of speed loop and brake; Increase the [Time to restart] TTR
clearing: If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [No] NO : This detected error requires a power reset; If the parameter [Extended Fault Reset] HrfC is set to [Yes] YES : This detected error can be cleared manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: IGBT short circuit error
causes: Power component detected error.
remedy: Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Motor short circuit error
causes: Short-circuit at drive output.
remedy: Check the cables connecting the drive to the motor, and the motor insulation.; Contact Schneider Electric Product Support.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Modbus communication interruption error
causes: Communication interruption on the Modbus bus.
remedy: Check the communication bus.; Check the time-out.; Refer to the Modbus User manual.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: PC communication interruption error
causes: Communication interruption with PC Software.
remedy: Check the PC Software connecting cable.; Check the time-out.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: HMI communication interruption error
causes: Communication interruption with the graphic display terminal or remote display terminal.
remedy: Check the terminal connection; Check the time-out.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Motor overspeed error
causes: Instability or driving load too high; If a downstream contactor is used, the contacts between the motor and the drive have not been closed before applying a Run command; The overspeed threshold (corresponding to 110 % of [Max Frequency] TFR) has been reached.
remedy: Check the motor, gain and stability parameters; Add a braking resistor; Check the size of the motor/drive/load; Check the parameters settings for the [Frequency meter] FQF- function, if it is configured; Verify and close the contacts between the motor and the drive before applying a Run command; Verify the consistency between [Max Frequency] TFR and [High Speed] HSP. It is recommended to have at least [Max Frequency] TFR ≥110% * [High Speed] HSP.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Encoder feedback loss error
causes: Signal on Pulse input missing, if the input is used for speed measurement; Encoder feedback signal missing.
remedy: Check the wiring of the input cable and the detector used; Check the configuration parameters of the encoder; Check the wiring between the encoder and the drive; Check the encoder.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Torque Limitation Error
remedy: Switch to torque or current limitation; Check if there are any mechanical problems; Check the parameters of [Torque limitation] TOL- and the parameters of the [Torque or I limit detect] TID-
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Process Underload
causes: Process underload
remedy: Check and remove the cause of the underload; Check the parameters of the [Process underload] ULD- function
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Brake feedback error
causes: The brake feedback contact does not match the brake logic control; The brake does not stop the motor quickly enough (detected by measuring the speed on the Pulse input input)
remedy: Check the feedback circuit and the brake logic control circuit; Check the mechanical state of the brake; Check the brake linings
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Dynamic load detected error
causes: Abnormal load variation
remedy: Check that the load is not blocked by an obstacle; Removal of a run command causes a reset
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed

name: Function block error
causes: Function block detected error.
remedy: See [FB Error] FBFT for more details.
clearing: This detected error is cleared as soon as its cause has been removed.

name: Function block stop error
causes: Function blocks have been stopped while motor was running.
remedy: Check [FB Motor Stop Type] FBSM configuration.
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: IGBT Overheating
causes: Drive overheated
remedy: Check the size of the load/motor/drive; Reduce the switching frequency; Wait for the motor to cool before restarting
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: Autotuning Error
causes: Special motor or motor whose power is not suitable for the drive; Motor not connected to the drive; Motor not stopped; If an output contactor is being used, close it during auto-tuning
remedy: Check that the motor/drive are compatible; Check that the motor is present during auto-tuning; Check that the motor is stopped during tune operation
clearing: This detected error can be cleared with the [Auto Fault Reset] ATR or manually with the [Fault Reset Assign] rsf parameter after its cause has been removed.

name: The Input parameter is outside the process value limits. Input > Config.InputUpperLimit; Input < Config.InputLowerLimit
causes: Input > Config.InputUpperLimit; Input < Config.InputLowerLimit

name: Invalid value at the Input_PER parameter. Check whether an error is pending at the analog input.
Error during fine tuning. Oscillation of the process value could not be maintained.
Error at start of pre-tuning. The process value is too close to the setpoint. Start fine tuning.
The setpoint was changed during tuning. Note: You can set the permitted fluctuation on the setpoint at the Cancel-TuningLevel tag.
causes: Note: You can set the permitted fluctuation on the setpoint at the Cancel-TuningLevel tag.

name: Pre-tuning is not permitted during fine tuning. Note: If ActivateRecoverMode = TRUE before the error occurred, PID_Compact remains in fine tuning mode.
causes: Note: If ActivateRecoverMode = TRUE before the error occurred, PID_3Step remains in fine tuning mode.

name: Error during pretuning. The cooling could not reduce the process value.
Error during pre-tuning. Incorrect configuration of output value limits. Check whether the limits of the output value are configured correctly and match the control logic.
remedy: Check whether the limits of the output value are configured correctly and match the control logic.

name: Error during fine tuning resulted in invalid parameters.
Invalid value at the Input parameter: Value has an invalid number format.
Calculation of the output value failed. Check the PID parameters.
Sampling time error: PID_Compact is not called within the sampling time of the cyclic interrupt OB.
Invalid value at the Setpoint parameter: Value has an invalid number format.

Invalid value at the ManualValue parameter: Value has an invalid number format. Note: If ActivateRecoverMode = TRUE before the error occurred, PID_Compact uses SubstituteOutput as the output value. As soon as you assign a valid value in the ManualValue parameter, PID_Compact uses it as the output value.
causes: The actuator cannot be moved to the manual value and remains in its current position. Assign a valid value in ManualValue or move the actuator in manual mode with Manual_UP and Manual_DN.
remedy: The error is cleared when a valid value is assigned to ManualValue or the actuator is moved manually using Manual_UP and Manual_DN.

name: Invalid value at the Feedback_PER parameter. Check whether an error is pending at the analog input.

Invalid value at the SubstituteValue tag: Value has an invalid number format. PID_Temp uses the output value low limit as the output value. Note: If automatic mode was active before the error occurred, ActivateRecoverMode = TRUE, and the error is no longer pending, PID_Temp switches back to automatic mode.
causes: PID_Compact uses the output value low limit as the output value.
remedy: As soon as the error is no longer pending, PID_Compact switches back to automatic mode.

name: Error with master in the cascade. Slaves are not in automatic mode or have a substitute setpoint enabled and are preventing tuning of the master.
Invalid value at the Feedback parameter: Value has an invalid number format.
Invalid value at the Disturbance parameter: Value has an invalid number format.
causes: If automatic mode was active and ActivateRecoverMode = FALSE before the error occurred, Disturbance is set to zero. PID_Temp remains in automatic mode. If pre-tuning or fine tuning mode was active and ActivateRecoverMode = TRUE before the error occurred, PID_Temp switches to the operating mode that is saved in the Mode parameter. If Disturbance in the current phase has no effect on the output value, tuning is not canceled.

name: Error during digital position feedback. Actuator_H = TRUE and Actuator_L = TRUE. The actuator cannot be moved to the substitute output value and remains in its current position. Manual mode is not possible in this state. In order to move the actuator from this state, you must deactivate the "Actuator end stop" (Config.ActuatorEndStopOn = FALSE) or switch to manual mode without end stop signals (Mode = 10).
